description: Full skill for AWS Route 53 DNS management for ndestates-io domains (hosted zones, nameserver delegation, record management). Specializes in email setup: domain verification TXT, DKIM CNAMEs, SPF, DMARC, MX for Amazon SES send + receive. Also handles general domain records (A, CNAME, etc.). Non-Microsoft (pure AWS). Complements .github/skills/amazon-ses-email/SKILL.md by automating DNS record application (no more manual DO DNS or registrar edits). Integrated with project-drift-guardian (DNS as code, pre/post checks), digitalocean (delegation or current registrar), security (least-privilege IAM), and evals. Use for initial domain bootstrap, SES email DNS, verification, ongoing mail-related records, and app subdomains. Enforces no-drift via cache + guardian. Always run from host with AWS CLI.
